summary.name: SuperCorners
summary.one_liner: SuperCorners is a Mac utility that turns screen corners and edge zones into triggers for custom actions such as opening apps, running system commands, or playing media.
use_cases: Launch apps or websites by moving the mouse to a corner
Toggle dark mode or keep the Mac awake with a flick
Trigger Apple Shortcuts from screen edges
Play, pause or skip media from a screen corner
Set up different corner actions for specific apps
summary.what_it_does: SuperCorners extends macOS Hot Corners by letting you assign actions to the corners and to the middle of any screen edge. The page says it offers over 70 actions, including opening apps and websites, system commands like Toggle Dark Mode and Keep Awake, Apple Shortcuts, and hotkey recording and simulation. Action sets can trigger globally or per app, and you can ignore corner actions for chosen apps. Users can also adjust how close the mouse must be to trigger an action and see toast notifications or a visual overlay when actions fire.
notable: Over 70 actions, including Apple Shortcuts and hotkey simulation
Triggers on middle of any screen edge, not just corners
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing marks it as open source and freeware
